DDR_PHY_Interface_Specification_v5_2.pdf.text: The t phy_wrcsgap timing parameter specifies the minimum number of additional Data clocks required between commands when changing the target chip select driven on the dfi_wrdata_cs signal and defines a minimum additional delay between commands when changing the target chip select as required by the PHY.
